description: SQLite converts a CAST by the affinity of the type it names, so a CAST to BOOLEAN, BOOL, JSON, JSONB, STRING or ANY, all of the numeric affinity, gives a number and reads as a decimal: 'true' and a JSON object cast to BOOLEAN or JSON give 0, '12abc' cast to STRING gives 12 and '2.5' cast to BOOL or ANY gives 2.5, while a CAST to TEXT keeps the text and one to BIGINT gives an integer; a parameter cast to BOOLEAN stays a bool, which binds as 1 or 0, so CAST(? AS BOOLEAN) filters every row or none. The same golden holds for modernc.org/sqlite and, through sqlite_cgo, mattn/go-sqlite3.
